AppTagline: Samsung DeX, phone mirroring, and independent Android app windows for Windows
DevicesSubtitle: USB ADB, encrypted TLS wireless ADB, and Miracast Wi-Fi Direct
DevicesEmptyBody: Device discovery and streaming backends are scheduled for M1 (ADB mirror & independent app windows) and M2 (Samsung DeX dual-channel). Use Diagnostics now to verify host drivers and hardware decoding.
ModesSubtitle: Designed without artificial mutual exclusion; real capabilities are probed per device and One UI version.
ModeDexDesc: Runs genuine Samsung DeX via wireless Miracast (without forcing USB debugging) or USB/Wi-Fi ADB loopback activation, with verified multi-window, taskbar, Recents, and desktop mouse behavior.
ModeMirrorDesc: Low-latency screen mirroring with keyboard/mouse, audio, clipboard, portrait/landscape rotation, borderless fullscreen, screenshots, recording, and screen-on or screen-off display modes.
ModeAppsDesc: Runs each Android app in its own native Windows window (taskbar, Alt+Tab, resize, Snap Layouts) on an isolated virtual display while your physical phone screen remains free.
ModeCoexistenceDesc: When hardware encoders or device policies restrict simultaneous modes, AndroFuse detects the limit, informs the user clearly, and falls back safely instead of failing silently.
DiagSubtitle: Live checks run on this machine without requiring Root or modifying system configuration.
DiagCoreMissing: Core DLL not found next to binary (build core/androfuse-core to enable native probes)
DiagWfdSummary: Wi-Fi Direct API: {wfd} · Miracast Sink IE: {ie}
DiagAdbMissing: Not found in PATH or standard Android SDK platform-tools (Miracast DeX does not require ADB)
SettingsSubtitle: Appearance, language, and baseline security defaults
SettingsSecurityBody: Encrypted TLS wireless ADB pairing is preferred over plaintext tcpip. Remote access and MCP control remain disabled by default. Diagnostic logs scrub device serials and local paths.
